description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Guile.
Guile and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Guile trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Guile, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Guile's power.
Repeat.
